items.detail: Dodgers center fielder Andy Pages suffered a fractured left hand when he was hit by a pitch Friday night, but manager Dave Roberts said he expects him to return this season.

items.headline: Sources: DeRozan joining Nuggets on 1-year deal
items.detail: Six-time NBA All-Star DeMar DeRozan has agreed to sign with the Denver Nuggets on a one-year, $3.9 million deal, sources told ESPN on Friday.

items.headline: 'This is it': Bengals' Joe Burrow tired of waiting, targets Super Bowl
items.detail: The Bengals improved their defense after missing the playoffs a third straight year. Will it be enough?

items.headline: Blue Jays' Guerrero (concussion) likely back Sat.
items.detail: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. passed his final concussion tests, and the Blue Jays slugger is expected to return from the seven-day injured list Saturday.

items.headline: Yankees' Fried set to start throwing off mound
items.detail: Yankees lefty Max Fried is scheduled to throw off a mound Saturday for the first time since landing on the injured list because of a recurrence of a bone bruise in his left elbow Tuesday.

items.headline: Engelbert: 'Haters' using WNBA to create conflict
items.detail: Commissioner Cathy Engelbert said the league is being used as a "political football for people who have never watched the WNBA."

items.headline: Stad takes controlling stake in T-wolves, Lynx
items.detail: American businessman Marc Stad has purchased and taken a controlling interest in the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx.

items.headline: Wings star Fudd out for season with knee injury
items.detail: Wings star guard Azzi Fudd, the No. 1 pick in this year's WNBA draft, will undergo a procedure on her injured right knee and miss the remainder of the season.

items.headline: Cunningham: WNBA needs 'bold' commissioner
items.detail: Sophie Cunningham said the WNBA needs a "bold" commissioner "who wants the best for the players and not maybe for themselves."

items.headline: Miami's Messi fined by MLS for slapping opponent
items.detail: Inter Miami's Lionel Messi and Ian Fray have been fined undisclosed amounts for making contact in the head and neck area of opponents in separate incidents during second-half stoppage time in a 2-2 draw against Philadelphia, MLS said Friday.

items.headline: Replica of PWHL's championship trophy missing
items.detail: A replica of the Walter Cup, the trophy that belongs to the Professional Women's Hockey League champion Montreal Victoire, is missing, the league told The Associated Press on Friday.

items.headline: NHL referee wins 4th Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur
items.detail: NHL referee Garrett Rank won his fourth Canadian Men's Mid-Amateur Championship on Friday.

items.headline: Broncos' Nix throws for TD in return from injury
items.detail: Broncos quarterback Bo Nix, who underwent two offseason surgeries to repair a fractured right ankle, made his first preseason appearance Friday night, playing 14 snaps and finishing 6-of-9 passing for 76 yards and a touchdown.

items.headline: 4-time Pro Bowl RB Chubb announces retirement
items.detail: Veteran running back Nick Chubb, a four-time Pro Bowl selection who most recently played for the Texans, announced his retirement Friday night.

items.headline: Sources: Klay set to join Heat after Mavs buyout
items.detail: Klay Thompson plans to sign a two-year, nearly $13 million deal with the Heat after clearing waivers following his contract buyout from the Mavericks, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
